before: A pasted list level took the default level text, no marker run properties, the default bullet glyph and font, and the default indents, whatever its @list rule stated.
after: The paste reads mso-level-text, the rule's font, color, weight, style, size, and underline, margin-left, text-indent, and mso-level-tab-stop into the pasted w:lvl.
reason: Only the values the paste writes into ordinary w:lvlText, w:rPr, w:ind, and w:tabs of a new w:lvl change. Released participants already store, replicate, and lay out those elements; shared nodes, operations, and package serialization are unchanged.
